name: Osoznanie
source:
The pioneer camp Sovyonok is an unusual place. No one ends up there without a reason. No one leaves it the same as before. Anyone can start their life over there, even when they have already lost all hope. A nobleman from another world and a redheaded rebel found each other under the sun of an endless summer. Do they have the right to a second chance? Can two people who are so completely different truly be together? And will they be able to meet again when their allotted time ends?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=727386378]Steam[/url]]
translation:
索维诺克先锋营是一个不寻常的地方。没有人会无缘无故地到达那里。没有人让它像以前一样。任何人都可以在那里开始自己的生活，即使他们已经失去了所有希望。来自异世界的贵族和红发叛逆者在无尽夏日的阳光下相遇。他们有第二次机会的权利吗？两个截然不同的人真的能在一起吗？当规定的时间结束后，他们还能再次见面吗？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=727386378]Steam[/url]]
